mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have mainly clear skies and a temperature of 67 degrees down by Reddan Soccer Park, accompanied by a waning crescent moon.

The City of Verona remains committed to infrastructure maintenance through its professional services agreement with AECOM Inc. Engineering reports are consistently provided to the City Council, with the most recent updates spanning from July 2024 through August 2026 available on the city website.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today. You can also catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by a Girls Try Hockey event tomorrow at the Verona Ice Arena.
In a recent report regarding calls from July 27th to August 3rd, police conducted a stop on July 31st where a driver was arrested for O W I and operating with a prohibited alcohol concentration.
Today's delicious flavor is the Andes Mint Avalanche. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM today for you to grab a scoop.
